segments.text: Thanks. I have the account up in the admin console. You're on the annual business plan through March 31, 2026. Adding 6 seats today will create a prorated charge of $1,134.00 for the rest of the term. Is that okay to process?

segments.text: You're welcome. Ticket 41628 is updated and closed. Have a good one.
